title: Final velocity after 3s
description: Essential: The response must correctly calculate and state the final velocity as 7 m/s.

title: Time for speed 21 m/s
description: Essential: The response must correctly calculate and state the required time as 10 s.

title: Apply velocity-time equation
description: Important: The solution must correctly apply the kinematic equation v = v0 + a*t for both parts.

title: Correct sign handling
description: Important: The solution must consistently treat westward as the positive direction for velocity and acceleration.

title: Unit consistency
description: Optional: The solution should include proper units (m/s, s) in calculations and final answers.

title: Algebraic manipulation
description: Optional: The solution shows clear algebraic steps to solve for the unknown time in part (2).

title: Sign/direction error
description: Pitfall: Penalize if the solution incorrectly uses negative signs for acceleration or velocity, leading to wrong magnitude or sign.

title: Formula misapplication
description: Pitfall: Penalize if the solution uses an incorrect kinematic equation (e.g., displacement equation) for these velocity-time problems.
